_how_to: Add a release slug with the links you want to force, e.g. "huka": {"spotify": "https://open.spotify.com/album/..."}. Use "" to hide a button, or "hidden": true to hide a whole release.

sweet-spot.blurb: Sweet Spot is exactly what the name suggests - that place where everything just feels right. Where sound, rhythm, and emotion meet in perfect balance. Two tracks come together as one soft, melodic, immersive journey, created to take you into a space that simply feels good to be in. No rush, no need to prove anything - just letting the music lead the way. Press play, enter the Sweet Spot, and stay there for a while.
